scripts.build: bun run --bun --cwd sdk build && bun run --bun --cwd packages/pi-durable build && bun scripts/build-runtime.mjs
scripts.format: cargo fmt --all && bun run --bun --cwd sdk format && prettier --write "scripts/*.mjs" "tests/scripts/*.mjs" && bun run --bun --cwd packages/observer-ui format && bun run --bun --cwd packages/pi-durable format
scripts.format:check: cargo fmt --all -- --check && bun run --bun --cwd sdk format:check && prettier --check "scripts/*.mjs" "tests/scripts/*.mjs" && bun run --bun --cwd packages/observer-ui format:check && bun run --bun --cwd packages/pi-durable format:check
scripts.test: bun run --bun --cwd packages/observer-ui test && bun test --timeout 60000 tests/scripts/*.test.mjs && cargo test --locked --no-fail-fast && bun run --bun --cwd sdk test && bun run --bun --cwd packages/pi-durable build && bun run --bun --cwd packages/pi-durable test && bun run --bun --cwd examples/pi/pi-cli test
scripts.docs:build: bun run --bun docs:check && bun run --bun --cwd sdk build && bun run --bun --cwd sdk docs
